# Security reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities through
[GitHub's private form](https://github.com/CZ-ZL/duo/security/advisories/new).
Do not include exploit details, credentials or private data in public issues.
If the form is unavailable, request a private channel without disclosing the issue.

The [package security policy](../dsh-plugin/SECURITY.md) defines the supported
scope and trust boundaries. DUO is a developer-preview DSH plugin: providers run
as trusted in-process code, and there is no DUO OS sandbox or response-time SLA.
Use the current verified source candidate; old tags remain historical artifacts.
